# uptimekuma_remote_browser (Resource)

A remote browser endpoint, used by real-browser monitors instead of the bundled Chromium.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_remote_browser" "chrome" {
  name = "Shared Chrome"
  url  = "ws://chrome.internal:3000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Friendly name for the remote browser.
- `url` (String) WebSocket endpoint of the browser, for example `ws://chrome:3000`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the remote browser, assigned by Uptime Kuma.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Monitors, tags, notifications and the rest are imported by their numeric ID,
# which is visible in the Uptime Kuma URL when you open the object.
terraform import uptimekuma_remote_browser.example 1
```
